ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at distal tips and the lower-medial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Monolithic black field with high-contrast white contiguous blobs localized at both distal tips. A dense cluster of high-intensity white point-source pixels (mottling) is mapped to the lower-central region surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; central vertex is clearly defined with an estimated pixel angle of 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the boundary. Two distinct, high-amplitude irregular indentations are visible on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the notch, terminating in irregular, high-contrast bulbous structures at the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Aggregated clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the distal tips, characteristic of barnacle colonization. A secondary constellation of small white circular marks is dispersed in the lower-central quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple discrete white linear pixel disruptions identified: one prominent 45-degree diagonal mark on the right lobe and several smaller, unaligned oblique marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear white scars (rake marks) on both lobes; substantial irregular trauma/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; dense white clusters at the fluke extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density and spatial arrangement of white stippling concentrated specifically in the region inferior to the median notch.
